tool.name: Samplot plot
tool.description: structural variant evidence in a genomic region
tool.command:
#import re #if str($titles).strip() #set $title_list = [t.strip() for t in str($titles).split(',')] ## samplot silently drops all titles when the count is off #if len($title_list) != len($alignments) or '' in $title_list echo 'Give exactly one non-empty title per alignment file, separated by commas' >&2 && exit 1 && #end if #end if @LINK_ALIGNMENTS@ #if $tracks.transcripts ## a literal hash would start a Cheetah comment, hence the [#] classes awk '/^[#][#]FASTA/{exit} !/^[#]/' '$tracks.transcripts' | LC_ALL=C sort -t \$'\t' -k1,1 -k4,4n > transcripts.gff3 && python -c "import pysam; pysam.tabix_index('transcripts.gff3', preset='gff', force=True)" && #end if #set $annotation_names = [] #if $tracks.annotations #for $i, $annotation in enumerate($tracks.annotations) awk '!/^[#]/ && !/^(track|browser)([ \t]|$)/' '$annotation' | LC_ALL=C sort -t \$'\t' -k1,1 -k2,2n > 'annotation_${i}.bed' && python -c "import pysam; pysam.tabix_index('annotation_${i}.bed', preset='bed', force=True)" && #silent $annotation_names.append(re.sub(r'[^\w\-. ]', '_', str($annotation.element_identifier))) #end for #end if
samplot plot --bams #for $aln in $staged_alignments '$aln' #end for --titles #if str($titles).strip() #for $title in $title_list '$title' #end for #else #for $aln in $alignments '${re.sub(r"[^\w\-. ]", "_", str($aln.element_identifier))}' #end for #end if @REFERENCE_ARG@ --chrom '$chrom' --start $start --end $end #if str($sv.sv_type) != 'none' --sv_type '$sv.sv_type' #if str($sv.sv_type) == 'BND' --chrom '$sv.chrom2' --start $sv.start2 --end $sv.end2 #end if #end if #if $tracks.transcripts --transcript_file transcripts.gff3.gz --transcript_filename '${re.sub(r"[^\w\-. ]", "_", str($tracks.transcripts.element_identifier))}' #end if #if $tracks.annotations --annotation_files #for $i, $annotation in enumerate($tracks.annotations) 'annotation_${i}.bed.gz' #end for --annotation_filenames #for $name in $annotation_names '$name' #end for $tracks.hide_annotation_labels #end if #if str($reads.window) --window $reads.window #end if --zoom $reads.zoom --max_depth $reads.max_depth --include_mqual $reads.include_mqual --separate_mqual $reads.separate_mqual --z $reads.z --long_read $reads.long_read --min_event_size $reads.min_event_size $reads.ignore_hp #if str($reads.max_coverage) --max_coverage $reads.max_coverage #end if --coverage_tracktype '$appearance.coverage_tracktype' $appearance.coverage_only $appearance.same_yaxis_scales $appearance.common_insert_size #if str($appearance.plot_height) --plot_height $appearance.plot_height #end if #if str($appearance.plot_width) --plot_width $appearance.plot_width #end if --marker_size $appearance.marker_size --dpi $appearance.dpi --output_file 'samplot.${output_format}' && mv 'samplot.${output_format}' '$plot'

param.label: Sample titles
param.help: Comma-separated titles, one per alignment file and in the same order. Leave empty to use the dataset names.

validator.message: Titles may contain letters, digits, spaces, commas, dots, underscores and dashes

param.label: Chromosome
param.help: Must match the sequence names in the alignment header, e.g. chr1 or 1

validator.message: Enter a single sequence name without spaces

param.label: Start position
param.help: Start of the region or variant

param.label: End position
param.help: End of the region or variant

param.label: Structural variant type
param.help: Draws a variant bar above the panels. Choose None to plot the region only.

validator.message: Enter a single sequence name without spaces

param.name: transcripts
param.label: Transcripts
param.help: GFF3 of genes and transcripts to draw under the alignments. It is sorted and indexed for you.

param.name: annotations
param.label: Annotation tracks
param.help: BED files such as repeats or mappability, one track each. Track names come from the dataset names.

param.label: Hide annotation labels
param.help: Hide the name column of the annotation BED files. Useful for regions with many features.

param.label: Window size
param.help: Number of bases to add on each side of the variant. Only used when an SV type is set. Default: half the variant length, widened to 1.5 times the fragment length for small variants.

param.label: Zoom
param.help: Only show this many bases around each breakpoint; much faster for large regions. Ignored for regions smaller than this.

param.label: Maximum number of normal pairs to plot
Minimum mapping quality
param.help: Reads below this mapping quality are left out of the plot.

param.label: Low mapping quality threshold for coverage
param.help: Coverage from reads with MAPQ at or below this value is drawn in a lighter grey. Use a negative value to disable.

param.label: Insert size cutoff (standard deviations)
param.help: Pairs whose insert size is more than this many standard deviations from the mean are treated as discordant.

param.label: Minimum long-read length
param.help: Reads at least this long are drawn as long reads.

param.label: Minimum long-read CIGAR event size
param.help: Smallest insertion or deletion inside a long-read alignment to draw.

param.label: Ignore HP tag
param.help: By default reads carrying a haplotype (HP) tag are drawn per haplotype.

param.label: Maximum coverage
param.help: Cap the coverage axis at this depth. Unlimited by default.

param.label: Coverage track type
param.help: How the coverage of low mapping quality reads is combined with the rest.

param.label: Show coverage only
param.help: Hide the reads and show only the coverage track.

param.label: Use the same Y axis scale for all samples
Use a common insert size for all samples
Plot height (inches)
param.help: Default: scaled with the number of samples.

param.label: Marker size
param.help: Size of the marks on pairs and split reads.

has_text.text: one non-empty title per alignment file

tool.help:
## What it does
Samplot draws the alignment evidence for a structural variant (SV) in one or more samples: read depth, discordant read pairs, split reads and long-read alignments, one panel per sample. Looking at the evidence side by side makes it quick to tell real SVs from false calls, and to compare a carrier with controls or parents.
## Inputs
- **Alignment files**: one or more coordinate-sorted BAM or CRAM files. Each file becomes a panel, titled with the dataset name unless you give your own titles. - **Sample titles** (optional): comma-separated, one per alignment file and in the same order. - **Reference genome**: only needed for CRAM input. - **Region**: chromosome, start and end. For an SV this is the variant itself; samplot adds a window on each side. For a translocation (BND) give the second breakpoint as well. - **SV type**: DEL, DUP, INV, INS or BND. This draws the variant bar above the panels and adds the window around the variant; choose *None* to plot exactly the region you entered. - **Annotation tracks** (optional): a GFF3 of transcripts, and BED files such as repeats or mappability. They are sorted, compressed and indexed inside the job, so plain uncompressed files are fine.
## Output
A single image in PNG, PDF or SVG format.
## Reading the plot
Discordant pairs and split reads are drawn as lines between their two ends, with the Y position giving the insert size. Colours encode the orientation of the pair (deletion-type, duplication-type or inversion-type evidence), as shown in the legend. The grey background is the read depth.
For more detail see the [samplot documentation](https://github.com/ryanlayer/samplot).
